summary: Tested the app after the SDK 58 upgrade (expo 58.0.19, RN 0.88.0, react 19.3.0, expo-router 58.0.26, gesture-handler 3.3.0, reanimated 4.7.1, screens 4.30). The deploy bug is fixed: react-native/asset-registry resolves to node_modules/react-native/src/asset-registry.js through the package exports map. `npx expo export --platform web` and `npx expo export --platform android --no-bytecode` both exit 0. Backend: 60 passed, 1 skipped. Frontend at 390x844: every requested flow passed, and the splash screen hides at runtime. The only console message was a benign web-only warning that useNativeDriver is unsupported in the flashcard Animated.spring. There were no page errors or red screens from gesture-handler 3, reanimated 4.7 or screens. No deprecated packages were found (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner and expo-background-fetch are absent).
action_items: OPTIONAL: /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log (06:43, before the current expo process) shows EmptyJsonFileError from @expo/cli UserSettings getSession (empty ~/.expo state json). The current expo process is healthy. If it recurs on restart, delete or fix the empty ~/.expo/*.json file.
critical_code_review_comments: The ESLint import/namespace error on expo-splash-screen is a false positive. build/index.d.ts does `export * from './SplashScreen'`, and at runtime the app renders past the fonts gate, so hideAsync is called.
flashcards/[category].tsx uses useNativeDriver: true. This only produces a fallback warning on web and is fine on native.
seed_data_creation: Browser dev_* devices were created via the quiz and simulation submits. One favorite (ntc-2018-stati-limite) was added on a throwaway browser device. One tutor chat message was sent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://state-exam-master.preview.emergentagent.com (-n 4 works). The flashcard counter is in the ScreenHeader subtitle ('N di M'). The simulation timer starts at 10:00 for 10 questions. Ripassa errori routes to /quiz/errori.
